# Cover-aware static reserve on general pair-root carriers

Status: prospective analytical candidate, OPEN pending independent analytical review, prospective publication, declared verification and scientific closeout. No new scientific enumeration has been performed. Parent: de41f3857b4c81690526fd6c0381bae07d0c0270, the completed nonuniform five-type checkpoint.

## Intent and native domain

Extend static reserve availability beyond the complete five-type root graph without promoting endpoint existence to reachability or importing a native observer. Retain original positive floors, original palette and original-footprint domination. No geometry, new outcome rule, full-state sensor, acknowledgment or commitment premise is derived.

Let H=(V,E) be a finite simple root graph with no isolated vertices. Roots are the edges of H; type v has footprint M_v consisting of the roots incident to v. Source type v has a_v>=1 distinct original labels, each with footprint M_v. Let A=sum_v a_v and let q be the minimum vertex-cover cardinality of H. Restrict the protected application to q in {3,4}. These source stars need not all be inclusion-maximal; domination by an original footprint and domination by an original maximal footprint are equivalent. No source type is missing.

Fix a saturation subgraph G=(V,E_G), E_G subset E. The ORIGINAL floor at root uv is a_u+a_v when uv is in E_G and 1 otherwise. A static admissible core uses the same A labelled palette, permits empty footprints, has each current footprint contained in some ORIGINAL M_v, meets every original floor, and has core hitting number at most FOUR. This is the inherited upper-four endpoint constraint for sources of hitting number three or four.

A static reserve means at least one original palette label is empty. It means neither a native path nor an observer-accessible record. The source hitting number is q. Let S={v:a_v=1}. Let C be any specified vertex cover of H with |C|<=4; it need not be minimum when q=3. Choose any one actual ORIGINAL label at each type in C as its anchor; these |C| label footprints must remain identical at the static endpoint. This is an endpoint preservation requirement, not a statement about an intervening path.

## Theorem

For each prescribed C and each such actual anchor choice, an anchor-preserving static reserve exists if and only if there is a nonempty independent set I in G such that

    |I| > |N_G(I)|    and    I intersect S intersect C = empty.

Consequently an unrestricted static reserve exists if and only if such a pair (C,I) exists for at least one vertex cover C of size at most four. In particular, whenever any static reserve exists, some static reserve preserves an actual original cover of at most four labels, possibly not a minimum cover. The same C works for EVERY choice of one original anchor label per type in C. This does not assert that every C works, or that a reserve can be reached with those labels unchanged.

The witness has explicit counts

    n_v = a_v - 1[v in I] + 1[v in N_G(I)].

It saves |I|-|N_G(I)| labels. Thus any existence witness, however large its count changes, implies a unit-per-type decrease/increase witness. Existence depends on the profile only through the singleton set S; actual multiplicities greater than one do not change the answer, although original floors and other quantitative questions do change.

## Proof for prescribed anchors

Necessity. Take a static endpoint with the prescribed anchors and at least one empty label. Expand each nonempty current footprint to some containing original star; choose the given star for each anchor. Expanding preserves floors and the actual anchor cover: those unchanged |C| anchors already cover all roots. Empty labels remain empty. Let n_v be the resulting type counts. Then sum n_v<=A-1, n_v>=1 for v in C, and n_u+n_v>=a_u+a_v on each saturated edge uv.

Put d_v=max(a_v-n_v,0), p_v=max(n_v-a_v,0). Since sum d_v>sum p_v, the finite integer layer identities sum d_v=sum_{h>=1}|{v:d_v>=h}| and sum p_v=sum_{h>=1}|{v:p_v>=h}| imply a level h with |D_h|>|P_h|. For any saturated edge from v in D_h, its other endpoint w must have n_w-a_w>=a_v-n_v>=h. Hence D_h is independent in G and N_G(D_h) is contained in P_h. Thus I=D_h has |I|>|N_G(I)|. If v is in S intersect C, n_v>=1=a_v, so it cannot be in I. This proves necessity without presupposing a bound on the endpoint's count changes.

Sufficiency. Given (C,I), independence gives I disjoint from N_G(I), so the displayed n_v are nonnegative integers. If v is in C and I, eligibility ensures a_v>=2, hence n_v>=1. All other types in C also retain at least one label. On saturated edge uv, a decreased endpoint has an increased neighbor; no saturated edge has two decreased endpoints. Thus n_u+n_v>=a_u+a_v. Each nonsaturated root has an endpoint in C, whose retained anchor alone meets its floor 1. These anchors cover every root, giving hitting number at most four. Domination and original palette are respected by assigning active labels to the indicated stars.

For the actual assignment, leave each chosen anchor unchanged. There are n_v-1 remaining positions at every v in C and n_v positions elsewhere, totalling sum n_v-|C| <= A-|C|-1. Assign that many distinct original non-anchor labels to these positions; leave the rest empty. No fresh label is introduced and no label is assigned twice. The particular original identity selected as each anchor is immaterial. This realizes the claimed endpoint for every anchor choice.

## Proof of unrestricted equivalence

Start from an arbitrary static reserve with a cover of at most four CURRENT labels. Expand every nonempty footprint to a containing original star. The selected covering labels still cover all roots after expansion. The set C of their star types is a vertex cover of H of size at most four; repeated star types are removed on taking this set. Therefore n_v>=1 on C. No minimum-cover assumption is used. The same deficit-level argument yields an eligible (C,I), and the constructive direction replaces the arbitrary endpoint by one preserving ORIGINAL anchors of that C. This replacement is static; no native route from the source or between endpoints is implied.

## Sharp upper-cover control beyond five types

Let H=K6 with only edge {4,5} removed, source a_v=1 at all six types, and G be H with all edges incident to type 0 removed. The unique independent pair in H is {4,5}; hence its unique minimum cover is C={0,1,2,3}, q=4. Type 0 is isolated in G but belongs to C.

The only deficient independent set in G is {0}. To verify this directly: on vertices 1..5 the only nontrivial independent pair is {4,5}, with neighborhood {1,2,3}. A single remaining vertex has at least three neighbors; adjoining isolated 0 does not make either of those sets deficient (the pair plus 0 has sizes 3 and 3). Thus {0} is the only deficit, and its singleton type lies in C, so the theorem excludes a static reserve.

Deleting the type-0 label is a floor-valid, original-dominated endpoint, but all five remaining types are needed to cover roots {0,w}, w=1..5. Its hitting number is 5 and it is inadmissible. This is a direct counterexample to generalizing “isolated saturated type guarantees a static reserve” or using deficiency without the cover condition. It is not a search-derived claim.

With a_0>=2 instead, the same I={0} is eligible and deletion of one type-0 label leaves an original type-0 anchor. With G isolating 4 or 5 instead, a singleton deletion is eligible because these types lie outside C. These are algebraic positive controls, not executed experiments.

## The source-three distinction is essential

Let H=K5 minus edge {3,4}, all a_v=1, and let G isolate vertex 0 by removing all H-edges incident to it. Source hitting number is three and the unique minimum cover is {0,1,2}. No deficient independent set avoids those singleton cover types: among the remaining types {3,4}, the pair has exactly two neighbors and either singleton has two. Thus no static reserve preserves this minimum cover.

Nevertheless C={1,2,3,4}, I={0} is eligible. Deleting the type-0 label preserves those four actual original anchors, meets all floors and has hitting number four. Thus a reserve exists in the original upper-four domain. Restricting C to minimum covers, or silently replacing upper-four by upper-source-tau, would wrongly reject this case. This is a hand-derived control, not an executed enumeration.

## Original protected completions

The theorem concerns the inherited core criterion of original floors, original domination and upper-four protection. It also preserves every original protected hidden completion under the same fixed hidden incidences. To see the lower protection directly, if the new full system had a cover of at most two labels, replace each selected current core label by any original label whose original footprint contains its new footprint. Keep any selected hidden labels. This yields an original full-system cover of at most two labels, contradicting its original lower-three promise. The current core anchors supply the upper bound of four regardless of the hidden completion. Core floors imply the required full-root floors. This is an endpoint guarantee, not a realized transition or observer acquisition.

## Reduction and boundaries

For H=K5, minimum covers omit exactly one vertex, so some C avoids I intersect S exactly when I contains at most one singleton. The theorem therefore recovers the closed five-type STATIC criterion, including isolates through I={v}; it does not re-prove that family's reachability/cost theorem. If all a_v>=2, the cover condition is vacuous for every C, and existence reduces to an independent-set deficiency in G.

Changing the root graph changes both the available covers and the meaning of an isolated saturated type. The five-type reachability criterion “static and minimum degree<=1,” four-anchor PATH theorem and costs 4/8/13 are not generalized here. Arbitrary root hypergraphs with roots supported by more than two source types, missing source types, exact labelled exchange/restoration, committed progress, native observation/access/retained output, broad C3 and general C4 remain OPEN.

The preserved C3 source screens require a justified native input, carrier/initial correlation, action connection and accessible retained output. This endpoint theorem supplies none of those objects. Path A remains active; Path B closed. No physical derivation or full-stack closure is claimed.

## Analytical review status
An independent analytical reviewer accepted the initial upper-source-tau statement and then explicitly accepted the strengthened exact upper-four statement above, without enumeration. The raw ANALYTICAL_REVIEW.md preserves both stages and the mandatory distinction between minimum covers and covers of size at most four. The initial draft is retained as historical INITIAL_ANALYTICAL_DRAFT.md, not the final scope. No computational or scientific-closeout acceptance is implied.

# Cover-aware static reserve — prospective finite verification scope

Status: prospective only; no campaign has run. The all-positive, arbitrary-finite-H result rests on RESULT.md's proof. This finite scope is deliberately complete within the following declared carrier/saturation families, not an enumeration of all carriers or native paths.

## Carrier and saturation families

Vertices use the indicated integer labels; roots are lexicographically ordered H-edges. Distinct family identities remain present even if any computed summary coincides.

1. H=K4 on 0..3: EVERY saturation subgraph G subset H (64), EVERY source profile a in {1,2}^4 (16).
2. H=C5 with edges 01,12,23,34,04: EVERY G subset H (32), EVERY a in {1,2}^5 (32).
3. H=K5: G is empty, H, or H with all edges incident to v removed for EACH v=0..4; also G is the K23 cross graph with parts {0,1} and {2,3,4}, with or without edge01. These nine G identities each take EVERY a in {1,2}^5.
4. H=K6 minus edge45: G is empty, H, or H with all edges incident to v removed for EACH v=0..5. These eight G identities each take EVERY a in {1,2}^6.
5. H=K5 minus edge34: G is empty, H, or H with all edges incident to v removed for EACH v=0..4. These seven G identities each take EVERY a in {1,2}^5.

The declared Cartesian family has 3,072 source identities (1,024+1,024+288+512+224). This is an a priori size calculation, not an execution result. All five carriers have source hitting number three or four. The upper endpoint bound is always FOUR, including source-three cases.

## Complete static reconstruction

For every source identity, independently enumerate ALL nonnegative count vectors n indexed by the H-types with sum n<=A. Reconstruct exactly those satisfying original pair floors and an occupied-type vertex cover of size at most four. Preserve the exact feasible count identities in canonical order, their minimum active total and every minimizing vector. Do not supply outcome-selected count lists or infer completeness from a hash alone.

Independently enumerate EVERY vertex cover C of H with |C|<=4, not only minimum covers; EVERY nonempty G-independent set I; every deficient I; and EVERY eligible (C,I) satisfying |I|>|N_G(I)| and I intersect {v:a_v=1} intersect C empty. For EACH C, compare criterion existence with direct feasible-count existence with n_v>=1 on C and sum n<A. Compare unrestricted existence with the complete feasible count universe. Preserve all positive and negative per-cover identities.

For EVERY eligible pair (C,I), construct the stated unit-redistribution counts and a canonical actual endpoint: reserve the FIRST original label at each C-type as anchor; process remaining type slots in increasing type order, assigning remaining original non-anchor labels in increasing label order; remaining labels are empty. Check all actual original floors, domination, the chosen actual anchors, emptiness count exactly |I|-|N_G(I)| and actual hitting number<=4. Also verify the same contract for the LAST original label at each C-type as anchor; retain distinct anchor-choice identities even when first and last coincide, but deduplicate full endpoint states for expensive checks. This tests two fully declared choices, not every mixed first/last choice or every original label assignment. The universal anchor-choice statement is analytical.

For every distinct canonical labelled endpoint, check EVERY original protected one-hidden mask: one new hidden label outside the original core palette, placed at each possible subset of the ORIGINAL roots E(H) for which the original full source has hitting number in {3,4}. Preserve exact protected-mask and endpoint identities, count endpoint occurrences separately from distinct endpoints, and compare all canonical records before their hashes. Do not claim enumeration of arbitrary labelled endpoints, multi-hidden states or paths. Arbitrary protected hidden-completion validity follows from the explicit domination/cover proof.

## Required discriminating controls

- H=K6-minus45, G isolating0, all singleton: no static reserve; the deletion endpoint passes floors/domination but fails upper-four with hitting number5. Deficiency-only and isolated-type shortcuts must be rejected.
- Same H/G with duplicated type0: static reserve exists with the original type0 anchor retained.
- Same H, G isolating4 or5, all singleton: static reserve exists with the unique four-cover preserved.
- H=K5-minus34, G isolating0, all singleton: static reserve exists via cover1234, while the unique minimum cover012 cannot be preserved. Reject minimum-cover-only enumeration and upper-source-tau substitution.
- K5 saturated K23, duplicated types: reproduce static existence without making a reachability assertion. The known locked-family boundary must not be relabelled as accessible.
- Reject omitted carrier/G/profile/C/I/count/minimizer/canonical endpoint/protected-mask identities; shifted original floors; illegal singleton depletion inside C; wrong actual anchor; a fresh label; and a claimed reserve without the exact deficiency count.
- Validate input domain: no missing types (a_v=0), no nonedges declared saturated, no isolated H-types, source hitting number outside {3,4}, no alleged C that fails to cover or exceeds four.
- Reject missing, truncated, extra and corrupted canonical streams. Rejection may use explicit verification exceptions; do not silently accept end-of-stream. This new checker need not reproduce the inherited deferred exception-type minor.

## Scientific loop and retained scope

Publish proof, this scope and implementation plan at an immutable prospective freeze BEFORE tests/enumeration. Then retain genuine missing-implementation RED; implement distinct producer and checker; run new scientific tests plus all378 immediate inherited tests; independently reconstruct complete canonical records and reproduce certificate/companion bytes. Exact-event GitHub verification, fresh reproduction, adversarial mathematical review and separate publication review are required. Preserve all raw reviews, original ZIPs/full logs/metadata, failures and attempts. Audit originals and evidence-rejection controls separately from scientific counts; obtain a fresh separate publication reviewer, update both indices and finish immutable text/blob/head readback before scoped CLOSED.

Performance may cache only explicitly equal complete count universes and original hidden-mask universes, preserving every source identity and its original floors/profile. No runtime-dependent sampling, outcome-based exclusions, reduced scope or weakened gate is allowed. If resources require an amendment, record and prospectively freeze it before running the amended campaign.

No first-vacancy route, connectivity classification, exact labelled repair/restoration, cost optimum, progress rule, observer initialization or broad C3/C4 closure is part of this contract.

# Independent analytical review — cover-aware static reserve

Review date: 2026-10-11 UTC. Parent checkpoint supplied for scope: `de41f3857b4c81690526fd6c0381bae07d0c0270`.

## Verdict

ACCEPT the prospective mathematical theorem as stated in `RESULT.md`, within its explicit endpoint domain. No blocking mathematical correction or counterexample to that statement was found. This is an analytical acceptance, not computational verification, publication approval, or scientific closeout.

I read `RESULT.md` and `progress.md`, and compared the static argument and boundary statements with `nonuniform_reserve/RESULT.md` and `private_cover/RESULT.md`. The review used proof reasoning and the small hand derivations below. No scientific enumeration, implementation, native-path search, GitHub write, or new verification campaign was performed. The supplied parent commit identity was not independently audited here.

## Proof audit

1. **Source and domination.** Since every type has at least one original label, covers by original stars correspond to vertex covers of H, so the source hitting number is q. This remains true when distinct vertices have equal stars or some stars are nonmaximal: the image of any selected labels is still a vertex cover, and repeated types cannot improve its cardinality. In the finite family, every original star is contained in an inclusion-maximal original star, so the two stated domination predicates are equivalent. The proof correctly retains all original types, rather than requiring anchors to be maximal.

2. **Expansion and prescribed anchors.** Each nonempty endpoint footprint can be assigned one containing original star. A prescribed anchor is assigned its own original star, so expansion leaves that actual label unchanged. Every original floor is monotone under expansion; empty labels stay empty. The q actual anchors continue covering every root, hence expansion also respects the upper-q gate. It is unnecessary and would be incorrect to assume that arbitrary expansion preserves an arbitrary upper-cover constraint without tracking a covering label set; this proof does track one.

3. **Unrestricted expansion and choice of C.** Select a cover by at most q current labels before expansion. After assigning containing stars, their distinct types form a vertex cover of H of size at most q. Minimality of q forces q distinct types and a minimum cover C. Thus n_v >= 1 on C. This covers duplicate containers, nonmaximal original stars, and endpoints whose original covering labels were not themselves original anchors. The subsequent construction produces a potentially different endpoint preserving original anchors; it does not retroactively identify those anchors with the covering labels of the first endpoint.

4. **Deficit-level necessity.** With d_v = max(a_v-n_v,0) and p_v = max(n_v-a_v,0), the vacancy gives sum d_v - sum p_v = A-sum n_v >= 1. Finite integer layer sums therefore yield some positive integer h with |D_h| > |P_h|. A saturated edge from v in D_h forces its other endpoint w to have surplus at least d_v >= h. Consequently D_h is independent, its open neighborhood is contained in P_h, and D_h is nonempty and deficient. If a_v = 1 and v belongs to C, the retained occupant gives d_v = 0. This proves precisely the claimed eligibility condition, including arbitrarily large initial endpoint deviations. No uniform-multiplicity assumption is used.

5. **Unit redistribution sufficiency.** For independent I, the open neighborhood N_G(I) is disjoint from I. Decreasing each I-count by one and increasing each neighborhood count by one keeps all counts nonnegative. A decreased type in C has multiplicity at least two, so every C-type retains an occupant. Every saturated loss is compensated at its opposite endpoint; all other saturated edges have no loss. Every unsaturated root meets C and therefore keeps its floor of one through a retained anchor. These same anchors enforce the upper-q gate. The total active count is exactly A-|I|+|N_G(I)|, so the construction saves exactly the stated positive deficiency.

6. **Actual labels and palette.** The q selected anchors are distinct actual labels. Once they are fixed, the remaining required positions total sum n_v-q, a nonnegative integer at most A-q-1. They can be filled injectively from the A-q original non-anchor labels, leaving at least one empty. A label may receive a star of a different original type because the stated admissibility rule is domination by some original footprint, not by that label's own footprint. That global interpretation is essential and is already explicit in the setting. The proof therefore supports every choice of original anchor identities for the same C.

7. **Profile dependence.** For fixed H and G, minimum covers and independent-set deficiencies are independent of a. The only multiplicity information in eligibility is membership in S={v:a_v=1}. Hence both prescribed-C and unrestricted existence depend only on S throughout the all-positive integer domain. This is an existence statement; it does not assert that every feasible endpoint is a unit redistribution, or that optimal reserve size or native cost depends only on S.

## Hand audit of the six-type rejecting control

For H=K6 minus edge 45, the sole independent pair is {4,5}; no independent triple exists. Thus the unique maximum independent set is {4,5}, and its complement C={0,1,2,3} is the unique minimum vertex cover, of size four.

When G removes all edges incident to 0, its nonempty independent sets consist of {0}, a singleton from {1,...,5}, the pair {4,5}, or one of the latter sets with 0 adjoined. Vertices 1,2,3 have four neighbors in G; vertices 4,5 have three. The pair {4,5} has neighborhood {1,2,3}. Adding isolated 0 leaves these neighborhood sizes unchanged. Thus neither a singleton, a singleton plus 0, the pair, nor the pair plus 0 is deficient; the last has sizes three and three. Exactly {0} is deficient.

With all multiplicities one, that unique witness meets S intersect C, so no admissible static reserve exists. Deleting the original type-0 label leaves every saturated root supported twice and every root 0w supported once. It satisfies the original floors and domination. The five roots 0w are each supported by their respective remaining type-w label alone, so all five remaining labels are indispensable and the endpoint hitting number is exactly five. This verifies the claimed rejection and the failure of the unrestricted isolate shortcut.

For a_0 >= 2, I={0} is eligible and removing one original type-0 label keeps a type-0 anchor. Isolating 4 or 5 instead permits deleting that singleton label while preserving C. Both positive controls follow directly without computation.

## Scope qualifications and optional strengthening

No theorem correction is necessary. Retain the following qualifications in any frozen or published statement:

- For q=3, the domain has upper bound three. It does not classify all endpoints in the inherited upper-four domain. For q=4 those bounds coincide.
- Anchor immutability is an endpoint requirement here. Neither the unit count formula nor assigning actual labels constructs a native route, preserves anchors along a route, gives edit costs, or solves a prescribed-label target problem.
- Original floors, original palette, all-positive multiplicities, pair-supported roots, and global original-footprint domination are part of the theorem, not conclusions to be weakened silently.
- The unrestricted result is existential in C. It neither says every minimum cover works nor preserves a predetermined original minimum cover at an arbitrary given endpoint.
- No C3 information origin, native observer, carrier correlation, access/retention mechanism, physical derivation, general C4 closure, or transfer of the private-maxima path theorem follows.

An optional small control makes the q=3 qualification concrete: take H=K5 minus edge 34, all multiplicities one, and G obtained by isolating vertex 0. The unique minimum cover is C={0,1,2}. An eligible I would have to lie in {3,4}; either singleton has two neighbors, while {3,4} has exactly two neighbors. Hence no eligible deficient I exists and the upper-three theorem excludes a reserve. Nevertheless, deleting type 0 meets all original floors and has hitting number four, because the four roots 0w each require their corresponding remaining label. Thus the looser upper-four domain does admit a reserve. This is a hand-derived illustration, not a new required computational scope.

For H=K5 itself, a minimum cover omits exactly one vertex, so a suitable C exists precisely when an independent deficient I contains at most one singleton type. This matches the parent static criterion; an isolated singleton is included via its one-vertex witness. None of the parent reachability or cost conclusions has been used in proving the general-root statement.

## Review disposition

The prospective theorem is suitable for scope freeze on the stated analytical basis. Computational checks, if subsequently authorized and declared, would corroborate finite instances rather than establish the all-positive, arbitrary-finite-H theorem. All later execution, publication, and closeout gates remain separate and unassessed by this review.

## Requested strengthening: exact inherited upper-four domain

After the preceding audit, the author requested analytical assessment of replacing the upper-q endpoint bound by four and permitting C to be any vertex cover of H with |C| <= 4. I ACCEPT this strengthening. It requires no enumeration and removes the need to impose the tighter upper-three endpoint domain when the source has q=3.

The precise strengthened statement is: retain finite simple H without isolates, all a_v >= 1, source vertex-cover number q in {3,4}, original saturated/unsaturated floors and the original palette/domination rules. A static endpoint is admissible when its hitting number is at most four. For any specified vertex cover C with |C| <= 4 and any one actual original anchor per C-type, an anchor-preserving static reserve exists if and only if some nonempty independent I in G satisfies |I| > |N_G(I)| and I intersect S intersect C is empty. An unrestricted upper-four static reserve exists if and only if at least one such pair (C,I) exists. Every affirmative instance consequently has an endpoint preserving an actual original cover of at most four labels, although that cover need not be minimum when q=3.

For fixed C, the proof above applies verbatim except that the number of anchors and the palette subtraction are |C|, not q: the remaining positions total sum n_v-|C| <= A-|C|-1. These anchors ensure the upper-four gate. The deficit proof uses only n_v >= 1 on C, not minimality of C.

For unrestricted necessity, select at most four current labels covering all roots and expand all nonempty footprints to containing original stars. Their set of distinct star types is a vertex cover C with |C| <= 4, and each C-type is occupied. The selected covering labels need not have distinct types; passing to the set of types is sufficient. No minimum-cover argument is needed. The layer proof then supplies eligible I and the construction realizes original anchors for that C. Unit redistribution and dependence only on singleton membership remain unchanged.

The six-type rejecting control is unaffected: q=4 forces every cover of size at most four to be its unique minimum cover. For H=K5, all covers of size at most four have size four, so the five-type reduction is also unchanged. In contrast, the q=3 hand example above now supplies the eligible pair C={1,2,3,4}, I={0}; the deletion endpoint has hitting number four as permitted. It also proves that the stronger upper-four theorem must not retain the assertion that every affirmative instance has a reserve preserving an original *minimum* cover. In that example the sole minimum cover is {0,1,2}, for which no eligible witness exists.

Necessary editorial changes if adopting this extension: state endpoint upper-four throughout; quantify over vertex covers C of size at most four; replace q by |C| only where counting selected anchors; remove the unrestricted minimality/distinct-type conclusion; and replace the unrestricted minimum-cover-preservation conclusion by preservation of some original cover of size at most four. The original fixed-minimum-C theorem remains a valid special case. The source restriction q in {3,4} and all endpoint-versus-path and native-premise boundaries remain intact.

"""Independent explicit-set reconstruction; never imports the producer."""
if not __debug__:
    raise RuntimeError("cover-static requires assertions enabled; optimized Python is unsupported")

import gzip
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import pathlib
import sys
from functools import lru_cache


def subsets(items,maximum=None):
    items=list(items)
    for n in range(len(items)+1 if maximum is None else min(maximum,len(items))+1):
        yield from itertools.combinations(items,n)


def declarations(fixture=False):
    out=[]
    for family,k,removed,cycle in [('K4',4,None,False),('C5',5,None,True),('K5',5,None,False),
                                 ('K6-minus45',6,(4,5),False),('K5-minus34',5,(3,4),False)]:
        edges=sorted({tuple(sorted((u,(u+1)%k))) for u in range(k)}) if cycle else [e for e in itertools.combinations(range(k),2) if e!=removed]
        if family in ('K4','C5'):
            graphs=sorted(subsets(edges),key=lambda es:sum(2**edges.index(e) for e in es))
        else:
            graphs=[(),tuple(edges)]+[tuple(e for e in edges if v not in e) for v in range(k)]
            if family=='K5':
                cross=tuple(e for e in edges if (e[0]<2)!=(e[1]<2))
                graphs += [cross,tuple(sorted(cross+((0,1),)))]
        for graph in graphs:
            for profile in itertools.product((1,2),repeat=k):
                out.append(dict(family=family,H=[list(e) for e in edges],G=[list(e) for e in graph],a=list(profile)))
    if not fixture:
        assert len(out)==3072
        return out
    requests=[('essential0','K6-minus45',0,False),('duplicate0','K6-minus45',0,True),
              ('isolate4','K6-minus45',4,False),('isolate5','K6-minus45',5,False),
              ('nonminimum','K5-minus34',0,False),('locked','K5',None,True)]
    selected=[]
    for name,family,isolated,duplicate in requests:
        matches=[]
        for source in out:
            if source['family']!=family:continue
            wanted=[2]*5 if isolated is None else [1]*len(source['a'])
            if duplicate and isolated is not None:wanted[0]=2
            graph=[e for e in source['H'] if isolated not in e] if isolated is not None else [e for e in source['H'] if (e[0]<2)!=(e[1]<2)]
            if source['a']==wanted and source['G']==graph:matches.append(source)
        assert len(matches)==1
        selected.append(dict(matches[0],name=name))
    return selected


def hitting(footprints,H):
    roots=set(map(tuple,H))
    for n in range(len(footprints)+1):
        if any(set().union(*selection)>=roots for selection in itertools.combinations(footprints,n)):return n
    return len(footprints)+1


def original_stars(s):
    edges=set(map(tuple,s['H']))
    return [{e for e in edges if v in e} for v,a in enumerate(s['a']) for _ in range(a)]


def validate_source(s):
    a=s['a'];H=list(map(tuple,s['H']));G=list(map(tuple,s['G']))
    assert a and all(type(n) is int and n>0 for n in a)
    assert H==sorted(set(H)) and all(0<=u<v<len(a) for u,v in H)
    assert G==sorted(set(G)) and set(G)<=set(H)
    assert set().union(*(set(e) for e in H))==set(range(len(a)))
    assert hitting([{e for e in H if v in e} for v in range(len(a))],H) in (3,4)
    return True


def validate_cover(s,C):
    assert len(C)<=4 and list(C)==sorted(set(C)) and all(0<=v<len(s['a']) for v in C)
    assert all(set(e)&set(C) for e in s['H'])
    return True


def validate_endpoint(s,state):
    assert len(state)==sum(s['a'])
    original=original_stars(s);G=set(map(tuple,s['G']))
    assert all(any(f<=m for m in original) for f in state)
    for u,v in s['H']:
        floor=s['a'][u]+s['a'][v] if (u,v) in G else 1
        assert sum((u,v) in f for f in state)>=floor
    assert hitting(state,s['H'])<=4
    return True


@lru_cache(maxsize=128)
def all_counts(H,total,floors):
    k=max(itertools.chain.from_iterable(H))+1
    valid=[]
    # Stars-and-bars via multisets, including a distinguished empty slot.
    for tokens in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(k+1),total):
        n=tuple(tokens.count(v) for v in range(1,k+1))
        if any(n[u]+n[v]<bound for (u,v),bound in zip(H,floors)):continue
        occupied=[v for v in range(k) if n[v]>0]
        if any(all(set(e)&set(C) for e in H) for C in subsets(occupied,4)):valid.append(n)
    return sorted(valid)


def reconstruct(s):
    validate_source(s)
    H=list(map(tuple,s['H']));G=list(map(tuple,s['G']));a=s['a'];k=len(a);total=sum(a)
    floor=[a[u]+a[v] if (u,v) in G else 1 for u,v in H]
    feasible=[list(n) for n in all_counts(tuple(H),total,tuple(floor))]
    minimum=min(sum(n) for n in feasible)
    independent=[];deficient=[]
    # Numeric membership order is part of the canonical format, not the enumeration algorithm.
    for I in sorted((c for c in subsets(range(k)) if c),key=lambda c:sum(2**v for v in c)):
        chosen=set(I)
        if any(set(e)<=chosen for e in G):continue
        neighbors=set().union(*(set(e)-chosen for e in G if set(e)&chosen))
        independent.append(list(I))
        if len(chosen)>len(neighbors):deficient.append(dict(I=list(I),N=sorted(neighbors)))
    cr=[];endpoints=[];original=original_stars(s)
    for C in subsets(range(k),4):
        if not all(set(e)&set(C) for e in H):continue
        validate_cover(s,C)
        eligible=[d['I'] for d in deficient if all(a[v]>1 or v not in C for v in d['I'])]
        direct=any(sum(n)<total and all(n[v]>=1 for v in C) for n in feasible)
        assert direct==bool(eligible)
        cr.append(dict(C=list(C),eligible=eligible,static=direct))
        for d in deficient:
            if d['I'] not in eligible:continue
            for choice in ('first','last'):
                labels_by_type=[];cursor=0
                for multiplicity in a:
                    labels_by_type.append(list(range(cursor,cursor+multiplicity)));cursor+=multiplicity
                anchors=[labels_by_type[v][0 if choice=='first' else -1] for v in C]
                counts=[a[v]-int(v in d['I'])+int(v in d['N']) for v in range(k)]
                state=[set() for _ in range(total)]
                for label in anchors:state[label]=original[label].copy()
                remaining=[label for label in range(total) if label not in anchors]
                slots=[v for v,n in enumerate(counts) for _ in range(n-int(v in C))]
                for label,v in zip(remaining,slots):state[label]={e for e in H if v in e}
                validate_endpoint(s,state)
                assert all(state[label]==original[label] for label in anchors)
                empty=sum(not footprint for footprint in state)
                assert empty==len(d['I'])-len(d['N'])
                bits=[sum(2**H.index(e) for e in footprint) for footprint in state]
                endpoints.append(dict(C=list(C),I=d['I'],N=d['N'],choice=choice,anchors=anchors,counts=counts,state=bits,empty=empty))
    masks=[];rootset=set(H);exposed_sets=[]
    for hidden in range(2**len(H)):
        exposed={e for r,e in enumerate(H) if not (hidden//(2**r))%2}
        if exposed and all(not exposed<=star for star in original):
            masks.append(hidden);exposed_sets.append(exposed)
    distinct=sorted({tuple(e['state']) for e in endpoints})
    # One bit per protected mask. Direct set inclusion constructs the complete
    # failure vector for each actual footprint; OR checks every declared pair.
    # Full endpoints contain original stars or empty, so equal footprints use
    # the same exact inclusion vector within this source, never a sampled mask.
    footprint_failures={}
    for bits in sorted({b for state in distinct for b in state}):
        footprint={e for r,e in enumerate(H) if (bits//2**r)%2}
        failures=0
        for index,exposed in enumerate(exposed_sets):
            if exposed<=footprint:failures |= 2**index
        footprint_failures[bits]=failures
    for state in distinct:
        assert all(footprint_failures[bits]==0 for bits in state)
    static=minimum<total
    assert static==any(c['static'] for c in cr)
    return dict(name=s.get('name',s['family']),source=s,floors=floor,feasible=feasible,minimum=minimum,
                minimizers=[n for n in feasible if sum(n)==minimum],independent=independent,deficient=deficient,
                covers=cr,static=static,endpoints=endpoints,distinct_endpoints=[list(c) for c in distinct],protected_masks=masks,
                hidden_checks=len(distinct)*len(masks))


def verify(data,fixture=False,identity_path=None):
    assert data['schema']=='cover-static-v1' and data['fixture']==fixture
    if identity_path is None:
        assert fixture,'Full verification requires canonical stream'
        iterator=iter(data['records']);handle=None
    else:
        try:handle=gzip.open(identity_path,'rt');iterator=iter(handle)
        except OSError as e:raise AssertionError('Missing identity stream') from e
    digests=[];counts=dict(sources=0,feasible_vectors=0,endpoint_occurrences=0,distinct_endpoints=0,hidden_checks=0)
    try:
        for s in declarations(fixture):
            expected=reconstruct(s)
            try:raw=next(iterator)
            except StopIteration as e:raise AssertionError('Truncated identity stream') from e
            actual=json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw,str) else raw
            assert actual==expected,'Canonical source record mismatch'
            line=json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n'
            digests.append(hashlib.sha256(line.encode()).hexdigest())
            counts['sources']+=1;counts['feasible_vectors']+=len(expected['feasible'])
            counts['endpoint_occurrences']+=len(expected['endpoints']);counts['distinct_endpoints']+=len(expected['distinct_endpoints'])
            counts['hidden_checks']+=expected['hidden_checks']
        sentinel=object();assert next(iterator,sentinel) is sentinel,'Extra identity record'
    except (OSError,EOFError,json.JSONDecodeError) as e:raise AssertionError('Invalid identity stream') from e
    finally:
        if handle is not None:handle.close()
    assert data['record_sha256']==digests and data['counts']==counts
    if identity_path is not None and 'identity_archive_sha256' in data:
        assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(identity_path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==data['identity_archive_sha256']
    return True

if __name__=='__main__':
    source=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);data=json.loads(source.read_text())
    verify(data,identity_path=str(source)+'.identities.jsonl.gz')
    result=dict(accepted=True,counts=data['counts'],certificate_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                canonical_sha256=data['identity_archive_sha256'])
    pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))

# Cover-aware static reserve implementation plan

> **For agentic workers:** Use superpowers:executing-plans for inline implementation. Fresh agents review mathematics, code and publication only; no implementation delegation. Existing research authorization applies; do not ask for routine permission.

**Goal:** Verify and close the general pair-root upper-four static criterion within the exact prospective contract, without claiming reachability or C3 acquisition.
**Architecture:** Independent producer/checker definitions of carrier families, profiles, covers, independent sets, complete count universes, canonical actual endpoints and original hidden masks. Producer uses bit masks/integer compositions; checker uses explicit sets, combinations-with-replacement counts and direct root coverage. Full canonical records compare before hashes; neither implementation imports the other.
**Tech stack:** Python standard library, unittest, deterministic JSON/gzip and established exact-event GitHub four-job review workflow.
**Spec:** RESULT.md and VERIFICATION_SCOPE.md; the strengthened upper-four RESULT is authoritative over the preserved initial analytical draft.

## Global constraints

- All-positive arbitrary-finite-H theorem is analytical; source hitting number3or4, endpoint bound4, original palette/floors/domination, all types present.
- C ranges over every cover of size<=4, including nonminimum covers. No inherited five-type reachability or cost statement is extended.
- Full declared3,072source family; ALL counts with total<=A; allC/I/per-cover classifications; first/last-anchor canonical endpoints; all original protected one-hidden masks for every distinct declared endpoint.
- Distinct producer/checker reconstruction; full canonical identities and exact byte reproduction; retain failures and genuine RED.
- All378inherited scientific tests plus the exact new total established by the written tests; evidence-audit controls remain separate.
- Freeze before computation; exact-event verification/fresh reproduction/two external reviews; original evidence reconciliation; fresh separate publication review; leased publication and immutable readback.
- C3 native input/carrier/action/retained-output requirements remain open. No full-state read, acknowledgment, hidden-dependent outcome rule or commitment primitive.

## Review focus

1. Nonminimum covers for source-three carriers: H=K5-minus34 must permit cover1234 when its minimum cover012 cannot be retained.
2. Upper-cover obstruction independent of floors: the all-singleton K6-minus45 isolated0 deletion has hitting5 despite satisfying original floors.
3. Nonmaximal source stars, shared type containers and actual original anchor identity: expansion cannot silently edit an anchor or restrict domination to its own type.
4. Completeness across equal cached universes: every H/G/profile/C/source identity remains bound, even when count vertices or summaries coincide.
5. Canonical endpoint/mask completeness and endpoint-versus-path claims: exact feasible vertices and original hidden checks are compared, while no route/commitment evidence is manufactured.

### Task1: Analytical acceptance and prospective freeze

### Task2: Complete static producer/checker and scientific controls

Create cover_static/producer.py, independent.py, test_cover_static.py, red.log, REPORT.md and REVIEW.md in the established research directory.
Interfaces: `producer.build(fixture: bool=False) -> dict`; `independent.verify(data: dict, fixture: bool=False, identity_path: str|None=None) -> bool`. Every source key includes carrier name, canonical H-edge list, G-edge list and ordered source profile. Fixture mode uses the two sharp singleton boundary controls, the duplicated type0 positive control and source-three nonminimum-cover positive control; it is never substituted for full scope.

### Task3: Exact-event remote verification and external review
